config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
headers = { "X-Catalog-Token" = "cat-secret" }

[catalog.model_providers]
"ghost" = "chatup"
name: m4_catalog_empty_readyz_503
_comment: Preserve the accepted Go readiness payload (ok/not ready); Python ready/not_ready payload parity is deferred. HTTP readiness and cached-catalog request-count assertions remain unchanged.
